title: Automatically deploy branches (= +PRS) to gh-pages for preview
body:
One thing we miss right now on the collaboration part is to be able to quickly visually see the result of a PR.

This could be solved by:

* deploy every opened PR to http://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/pr/#number/..
* it will make the PR docs accessible and possibly any change/new example. Much easier to comment/iterate
* we can use travis hooks on PRS, and reuse the gh-pages script (with some little tweaking so that we do not erase anything) to deploy
* after publishing, we should post a comment in the github issue
* then about cleaning merged PRS. When the v2 branch is built, we just list all closed PRS and we delete possible artifacts (or we use a github hook to do so, but never did that) from gh-pages

What do you think?
